units: viewBox user units; every transform is an SVG transform attribute about the listed pivot (equivalent to transform-box: view-box)
order: bloom, pinch-root > [tail, legs, body > [antenna-l, antenna-r, torso, belly, blush, eye-l > lid-l, eye-r > lid-r, mouth], arm-l > claw-l > [jaw-l-bottom, jaw-l-top, palm, paper], arm-r > claw-r > [jaw-r-bottom, lens > [lens-glow, lens-view > lens-eye, rim, lens-glint], jaw-r-top, palm], sweat, zzz], sparkle

pinch-root.transforms: translate(0,bodyY) rotate(tilt + 2*lookX, feet) scale(1/sqrt(bodySquash), bodySquash, feet)

lid-l.transforms: translate(0, coverage*lidSpan) rotate(-browL, lid edge); clipped to the eye

mouth.transforms: rotate(mouthTilt); child shape by mouth; smile scaleY(mouthCurve) about its corners

jaw-r-top.transforms: as jaw-l-top (the claw frame is mirrored, same signed angle closes)

lens.transforms: translate(lens*lensRaise.slide) scale(lensZoom, glass) scale(1-0.35*lensOut, grip); opacity 1-lensOut

lens-glint.transforms: static specular arcs at 10 and 2 o'clock

lens-sweep.transforms: translate along the 45 deg diagonal (-1.25..1.25)*r by glint; opacity sin(pi*glint); clipped to the glass

lens-view.transforms: opacity smoothstep(0.72,0.96,lens); clipped to the glass

lens-eye.transforms: matrix = inverse(world(lens)) * scale(1.5 about the glass centre in world) * world(eye-r)

zzz.transforms: opacity zzz; z0..z2 drift (5,-11)*phase on a 2400 ms cycle

params.name: bodySquash
params.drives: pinch-root scale about the feet [80,148]; scaleX = 1/sqrt(scaleY)

params.name: bodyY
params.drives: pinch-root translateY (hops: ease-out up, ease-in down)

params.name: tilt
params.drives: pinch-root rotate about the feet; lookX adds a 2 deg lean

params.name: clawL
params.drives: arm-l rotate about the shoulder (+ raises); claw-l counter-rotates -0.8x so it stays upright

params.name: clawR
params.drives: arm-r rotate about the shoulder (+ raises, mirrored sign); claw-r counter-rotates -0.8x

params.name: wristL
params.drives: extra claw-l rotate about the wrist (+ turns the crusher in toward the face: thinking, clap)

params.name: wristR
params.drives: extra claw-r rotate about the wrist, mirrored sense

params.name: pinch
params.drives: both claws: -1 wide open, 0 rest gap, 1 jaws meet (close_deg)

params.name: pinchL
params.drives: crusher only, added to pinch and clamped

params.name: pinchR
params.drives: cutter only (grips the lens handle), added to pinch and clamped

params.name: eyeOpen
params.drives: both lids: coverage = 1 - eyeOpen; above 1 the eyes scale up (surprise 1.15)

params.name: lidL
params.drives: extra lid coverage on eye-l, combined 1-(1-a)(1-b) with eyeOpen (sideeye dry lid 0.4)

params.name: lidR
params.drives: extra lid coverage on eye-r

params.name: browL
params.drives: lid-l tilt: + kind (outer corner down), - dry; never a frown

params.name: browR
params.drives: lid-r tilt, same sense mirrored

params.name: joy
params.drives: crossfade the eyes to happy closed ^ ^ arcs (celebrate)

params.name: lookX
params.drives: eye-l/eye-r translateX +-3.5 (lids ride along), body lean 2 deg

params.name: lookY
params.drives: eye-l/eye-r translateY +-2.5

params.name: mouth
params.drives: the only shape swap: smile | flat | open | o (step)

params.name: mouthCurve
params.drives: smile height (0 = flat line, 1 = rest smile); clamped at -0.2, never a frown

params.name: mouthTilt
params.drives: mouth rotate about its centre (half smile)

params.name: blush
params.drives: blush opacity (pinch-blush already carries its alpha)

params.name: antennaSway
params.drives: both antennae rotate the same way (right one x0.85)

params.name: antennaLift
params.drives: antennae perk up (+) or droop (-), mirrored

params.name: sparkle
params.drives: sparkle opacity and burst scale 0.72 -> 1.06

params.name: sweat
params.drives: sweat drop opacity, slides 3.5 px down as it appears

params.name: zzz
params.drives: z opacity; the three z's drift on a 2400 ms cycle of engine time

params.name: lens
params.drives: 0 lowered in the cutter -> 1 glass on eye-r (IK macro on arm-r, claw-r, lens); lens-view shows the magnified eye from 0.72

params.name: lensGlow
params.drives: camera light: green wash in the glass + a ring outside the rim. Carries information: never animate it for decoration

params.name: lensZoom
params.drives: lens scale about the glass centre (the tap toward the viewer)

params.name: lensOut
params.drives: lens tucked away (opacity 0, scale 0.65 about the grip) so both claws can clap

params.name: glint
params.drives: one green glint sweeps across the glass, opacity sin(pi*glint) (connected)

params.name: paper
params.drives: paper slip in the crusher (reading)

params.name: bloom
params.drives: the one allowed gradient, behind Pinch, celebrate only
